drafts.title: KokoroSharp: A New Local, Cross-Platform TTS Engine in C# Now on NuGet and GitHub
drafts.body: KokoroSharp is a recently introduced local text-to-speech engine written in C#, designed to be cross-platform and beginner-friendly yet flexible. It emerged from an effort to leverage a new high-performance audio model called Kokoro, with the author pivoting from an offline AI voice chat app to build this TTS solution. The engine is available as a NuGet package and the source code is open on GitHub, making it accessible for experimentation and integration. However, details on performance, audio quality, and hardware requirements remain scarce. For those interested in offline AI voice chat or speech synthesis projects, what practical experiences do you have with KokoroSharp regarding stability and output quality? Are there notable limitations in processing speed or voice naturalness that might affect real-time applications?
